attributes.action: Stop Wickham Park Golf Housing Build
attributes.additional_details: An excellent 18 hole golf course used by all ages will be affected with it's around 750 members affected. The local area has had 6000 homes permission given and this along with this proposal will affect all local residents and put a strain on local healthcare, schools, roads and the communion Wickham. It is not needed with the 6000 homes being built a very short distance away. This is a money making development and not one needed or wanted by the local area and the golfers
